description: This file defines a LinkedList class implemented in Kotlin, including methods for adding, removing, retrieving size, and accessing elements by index. It also contains an internal Node class used for list nodes.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation providing basic list operations such as add, remove, size, and get. Uses an internal Node class to store elements.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Inner class representing a node in the linked list, holding data and reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of an element from the list, returns true if removal was successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specific index in the list.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private method to unlink a node from the linked list during removal.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Companion object function that returns the last node in the list starting from the head.
